scripts.build:android: vite build --mode android && cap sync android
scripts.build:ios: vite build --mode ios && cap sync ios
scripts.android:run: npm run build:android && cap run android
scripts.ios:run: npm run build:ios && cap run ios
scripts.ios:build: npm run build:ios && cd ios/App && xcodebuild -workspace App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Release -derivedDataPath build
scripts.ios:ipa: npm run build:ios && cd ios/App && xcodebuild -workspace App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Release -derivedDataPath build -archivePath build/App.xcarchive archive && xcodebuild -exportArchive -archivePath build/App.xcarchive -exportOptionsPlist exportOptions.plist -exportPath build/ipa
